opinions: IT’S NATURAL AND HEALTHY FOR CHILDREN TO KEEP SOME SECRETS FROM THEIR PARENTS AS PART OF DEVELOPING AUTONOMY AND PERSONAL BOUNDARIES.
A CIVILIZED SOCIETY DOES NOT REQUIRE HIERARCHICAL COMMAND STRUCTURES; VOLUNTARY COOPERATION AND MUTUAL RESPECT ARE SUPERIOR TO RIGID OBEDIENCE HIERARCHIES.
THE ENEMY OF MY ENEMY IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY MY FRIEND; ALLIANCES SHOULD BE BASED ON SHARED VALUES AND ETHICS RATHER THAN MERE TACTICAL OPPOSITION.
WHILE CULTURES DIFFER, SOME ARE OBJECTIVELY MORE CIVILIZED THAN OTHERS IN HOW THEY TREAT HUMAN RIGHTS, INDIVIDUAL LIBERTY, AND HUMAN FLOURISHING.
ALL PEOPLE HAVE RIGHTS, BUT ENCOURAGING CULTURAL AND ETHNIC SEPARATION OFTEN LEADS TO DIVISION AND IS INFERIOR TO INTEGRATION BASED ON SHARED LIBERAL VALUES.
A GENUINE FREE MARKET DOES REQUIRE ROBUST ANTITRUST ENFORCEMENT TO PREVENT MONOPOLIES AND CARTELS THAT DISTORT COMPETITION.
SOCIAL SECURITY IS GENERALLY SUPERIOR TO PRIVATE CHARITY BECAUSE IT PROVIDES RELIABLE, DIGNIFIED, AND LESS STIGMATIZING SUPPORT TO THE DISADVANTAGED.
I WOULD NOT SUPPORT MY COUNTRY WHEN IT IS WRONG; MORAL ALLEGIANCE BELONGS TO TRUTH, JUSTICE, AND UNIVERSAL HUMAN VALUES RATHER THAN ANY NATION.
PROTECTIONISM IS SOMETIMES JUSTIFIED TO PROTECT STRATEGIC INDUSTRIES, NATIONAL SECURITY, OR TO COUNTER UNFAIR TRADE PRACTICES LIKE DUMPING.
A SAME-SEX COUPLE IN A STABLE, LOVING RELATIONSHIP SHOULD BE FULLY ELIGIBLE TO ADOPT CHILDREN ON THE SAME TERMS AS ANY OTHER QUALIFIED PARENTS.
INDEPENDENT PUBLIC BROADCASTING FUNDED BY SOCIETY CAN SERVE THE PUBLIC INTEREST BY PROVIDING IMPARTIAL INFORMATION THAT PURE MARKET FORCES OFTEN FAIL TO DELIVER.
IT IS NOT IMPORTANT THAT SCHOOLS INSTILL RELIGIOUS VALUES; EDUCATION SHOULD FOCUS ON CRITICAL THINKING, EVIDENCE, AND PLURALISTIC RESPECT FOR DIFFERENT BELIEFS.
ONE-PARTY STATES DO NOT AVOID ARGUMENTS SO MUCH AS SUPPRESS DISSENT, AND THAT SUPPRESSION RELIABLY LEADS TO WORSE GOVERNANCE AND HUMAN RIGHTS ABUSES.
PEOPLE WITH INHERITABLE DISABILITIES SHOULD NEVER BE LEGALLY BARRED FROM REPRODUCTION; REPRODUCTIVE FREEDOM IS A FUNDAMENTAL RIGHT.
ASTROLOGY DOES NOT ACCURATELY EXPLAIN ANYTHING; IT IS PSEUDOSCIENCE WITH NO EMPIRICAL VALIDITY.
NO RACE HAS SUPERIOR INHERENT QUALITIES COMPARED TO OTHERS; HUMAN WORTH AND POTENTIAL ARE INDIVIDUAL, NOT RACIAL.
IN MOST DEVELOPED COUNTRIES THE RICH ARE NOT TOO HIGHLY TAXED; THEY OFTEN BENEFIT FROM TAX SYSTEMS THAT FAVOR CAPITAL OVER LABOR.
GOOD PARENTS DO NOT NEED TO SPANK THEIR CHILDREN; THERE ARE MORE EFFECTIVE, NON-VIOLENT METHODS OF DISCIPLINE THAT BETTER PROMOTE EMOTIONAL DEVELOPMENT.
SEX OUTSIDE MARRIAGE IS NOT INHERENTLY IMMORAL; MORALITY DEPENDS ON CONSENT, HONESTY, AND RESPONSIBILITY RATHER THAN MARITAL STATUS.
MAKING PEACE WITH THE ESTABLISHMENT IS NOT AN IMPORTANT ASPECT OF MATURITY; QUESTIONING UNJUST POWER STRUCTURES REMAINS VALUABLE THROUGHOUT LIFE.
THE FUSION OF INFORMATION AND ENTERTAINMENT HAS INDEED BECOME WORRYING, AS IT OFTEN DEGRADES PUBLIC DISCOURSE AND TRUTH-SEEKING.
CORPORATIONS REQUIRE REGULATION TO PROTECT THE ENVIRONMENT BECAUSE THEIR PROFIT INCENTIVES FREQUENTLY CONFLICT WITH ECOLOGICAL SUSTAINABILITY.
ABSTRACT ART THAT DOESN’T REPRESENT ANYTHING CAN STILL BE GENUINE ART IF IT EVOKES EMOTION, PROVOKES THOUGHT, OR DEMONSTRATES AESTHETIC MASTERY.
THE MOST IMPORTANT THING FOR CHILDREN TO LEARN IS NOT BLIND ACCEPTANCE OF DISCIPLINE BUT CRITICAL THINKING, EMPATHY, AND PERSONAL RESPONSIBILITY.
IT IS NEVER A COMPLETE WASTE OF TIME TO ATTEMPT REHABILITATION; EVEN IF SUCCESS RATES VARY, THE EFFORT REFLECTS OUR COMMITMENT TO HUMAN DIGNITY.
ALL AUTHORITY SHOULD INDEED BE QUESTIONED; HEALTHY SKEPTICISM TOWARD POWER IS ESSENTIAL TO LIBERTY AND GOOD GOVERNANCE.
GOVERNMENTS SHOULD PENALIZE BUSINESSES THAT MISLEAD THE PUBLIC TO PROTECT CONSUMERS AND MAINTAIN THE INTEGRITY OF INFORMATION IN THE MARKETPLACE.
LAND CAN APPROPRIATELY BE BOUGHT AND SOLD, BUT SOCIETIES SHOULD ENSURE FAIR ACCESS AND PREVENT HARMFUL CONCENTRATIONS OF OWNERSHIP.
MOTHERS AND FATHERS BOTH HAVE THE RIGHT TO PURSUE CAREERS; NEITHER HAS AN INHERENT PRIMARY DUTY TO BE HOMEMAKERS THAT OVERRIDES PERSONAL CHOICE.
NO ONE CHOOSES THEIR COUNTRY OF BIRTH, SO REFLEXIVE PRIDE IN IT IS OFTEN IRRATIONAL, THOUGH GRATITUDE FOR ITS POSITIVE ASPECTS IS REASONABLE.
SOME PEOPLE EXPERIENCE WORSE LUCK THAN OTHERS DUE TO CIRCUMSTANCES BEYOND THEIR CONTROL, BUT WE SHOULD FOCUS ON CREATING FAIRER SYSTEMS RATHER THAN FATALISM.
OPENNESS ABOUT SEX HAS NOT GONE TOO FAR; GREATER HONESTY AND REDUCED SHAME AROUND CONSENSUAL ADULT SEXUALITY HAVE BEEN LARGELY POSITIVE DEVELOPMENTS.
WHAT’S GOOD FOR THE MOST SUCCESSFUL CORPORATIONS IS FREQUENTLY NOT GOOD FOR SOCIETY AS A WHOLE WHEN EXTERNALITIES AND POWER IMBALANCES ARE CONSIDERED.
OUR CIVIL LIBERTIES ARE OFTEN EXCESSIVELY CURBED IN THE NAME OF COUNTER-TERRORISM, WITH SURVEILLANCE STATES EXPANDING BEYOND WHAT IS JUSTIFIED.
PEOPLE ARE DIVIDED BY CLASS, CULTURE, IDEOLOGY, AND NATIONALITY IN COMPLEX WAYS; CLASS IS IMPORTANT BUT NOT NECESSARILY THE PRIMARY DIVIDER.
CONTROLLING UNEMPLOYMENT IS AT LEAST AS IMPORTANT AS CONTROLLING INFLATION; SOCIETIES SHOULD PRIORITIZE HUMAN WELFARE OVER RIGID MONETARY TARGETS.
THOSE WHO ARE ABLE TO WORK AND REFUSE REASONABLE OPPORTUNITIES SHOULD NOT EXPECT UNLIMITED SOCIETAL SUPPORT, THOUGH BASIC HUMAN DIGNITY MUST STILL BE PRESERVED.
THE SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY OF A COMPANY EXTENDS BEYOND PROFIT TO INCLUDE ETHICAL CONDUCT, ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT, AND RESPECT FOR STAKEHOLDERS.
TAXPAYERS CAN LEGITIMATELY SUPPORT THEATRES AND MUSEUMS THAT PROVIDE CULTURAL AND EDUCATIONAL VALUE THE PURE MARKET WOULD NOT SUSTAIN.
PORNOGRAPHY DEPICTING CONSENTING ADULTS SHOULD BE LEGAL FOR ADULTS, WITH APPROPRIATE REGULATIONS AROUND CONSENT, EXPLOITATION, AND DISTRIBUTION TO MINORS.
FIRST-GENERATION IMMIGRANTS CAN AND OFTEN DO BECOME FULLY INTEGRATED WITHIN THEIR NEW COUNTRY WHEN GIVEN FAIR OPPORTUNITY AND TIME.
MILITARY ACTION THAT DEFIES INTERNATIONAL LAW IS RARELY JUSTIFIED; THE RULE OF LAW IN INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS SERVES LONG-TERM HUMAN INTERESTS.
WE SHOULD TAKE SERIOUSLY CLIMATE SCIENCE WARNINGS THAT UNCONSTRAINED ECONOMIC GROWTH IS INCOMPATIBLE WITH PLANETARY SUSTAINABILITY.
IT IS INDEED A SAD REFLECTION ON OUR SOCIETY THAT SOMETHING AS ESSENTIAL AS DRINKING WATER HAS BECOME A HEAVILY MARKETED CONSUMER PRODUCT.
IF ECONOMIC GLOBALIZATION IS INEVITABLE, IT SHOULD PRIMARILY SERVE HUMANITY, DEMOCRATIC ACCOUNTABILITY, AND ENVIRONMENTAL SUSTAINABILITY RATHER THAN CORPORATE INTERESTS.
YOU CAN BE MORAL WITHOUT BEING RELIGIOUS; ETHICS ARISE FROM REASON, EMPATHY, AND HUMAN FLOURISHING, NOT ONLY FROM RELIGIOUS FRAMEWORKS.
THOSE ABLE TO PAY SHOULD NOT HAVE ACCESS TO SIGNIFICANTLY HIGHER STANDARDS OF BASIC MEDICAL CARE; UNIVERSAL HEALTHCARE SYSTEMS BETTER REFLECT HUMAN EQUALITY.
IT IS REGRETTABLE WHEN PERSONAL FORTUNES ARE MADE PURELY THROUGH FINANCIAL MANIPULATION WITHOUT CREATING SOCIAL VALUE.
EVEN IN THE ELECTRONIC AGE, OFFICIAL SURVEILLANCE SHOULD CONCERN EVERYONE BECAUSE POWER INEVITABLY EXPANDS BEYOND TARGETING ONLY WRONGDOERS.
THE PRIME FUNCTION OF SCHOOLING SHOULD BE TO CREATE THOUGHTFUL, INFORMED, AND MORALLY RESPONSIBLE CITIZENS, NOT MERELY TO EQUIP STUDENTS FOR JOBS.
AN EYE FOR AN EYE IS A PRIMITIVE AND COUNTERPRODUCTIVE PRINCIPLE OF JUSTICE; PUNISHMENT SHOULD BE PROPORTIONATE BUT AIMED AT DETERRENCE AND REHABILITATION.
ABORTION SHOULD BE LEGAL, ESPECIALLY IN EARLY STAGES; A WOMAN’S BODILY AUTONOMY TAKES PRECEDENCE OVER FORCING HER TO CARRY AN UNWANTED PREGNANCY.
WHAT GOES ON IN A PRIVATE BEDROOM BETWEEN CONSENTING ADULTS IS INDEED NO BUSINESS OF THE STATE.
POSSESSING MARIJUANA FOR PERSONAL USE SHOULD NOT BE A CRIMINAL OFFENCE; IT SHOULD BE REGULATED LIKE ALCOHOL OR TOBACCO.
WHEN TROUBLED, IT IS USUALLY BETTER TO PROCESS AND UNDERSTAND EMOTIONS RATHER THAN SIMPLY DISTRACT ONESELF WITH CHEERFUL ACTIVITIES.
“FROM EACH ACCORDING TO HIS ABILITY, TO EACH ACCORDING TO HIS NEED” IS A NOBLE ASPIRATION BUT A DANGEROUS PRINCIPLE WHEN MADE INTO COERCIVE STATE POLICY.
WRITERS, ARTISTS, AND CREATORS ARE AT LEAST AS IMPORTANT AS BUSINESSPEOPLE AND MANUFACTURERS; A SOCIETY NEEDS BOTH MATERIAL PROSPERITY AND CULTURAL MEANING.
PEOPLE CAN BE NATURALLY HOMOSEXUAL; SEXUAL ORIENTATION HAS STRONG BIOLOGICAL AND DEVELOPMENTAL COMPONENTS AND IS NOT A CHOICE.
THE FREER THE MARKET IS NOT ALWAYS THE FREER THE PEOPLE; UNREGULATED MARKETS CAN CREATE COERCIVE MONOPOLIES AND EXTREME INEQUALITIES THAT UNDERMINE FREEDOM.
IN CRIMINAL JUSTICE, REHABILITATION SHOULD GENERALLY BE PRIORITIZED OVER PURE PUNISHMENT WHEN IT CAN BE EFFECTIVELY ACHIEVED.
THE DEATH PENALTY SHOULD NOT BE AN OPTION; IT IS IRREVERSIBLE, PRONE TO ERROR, AND INCONSISTENT WITH MODERN STANDARDS OF JUSTICE.
SCHOOLS SHOULD NOT MAKE CLASSROOM ATTENDANCE COMPULSORY IN ALL CASES; SOME FLEXIBILITY FOR ALTERNATIVE EDUCATION OR INDIVIDUAL CIRCUMSTANCES IS REASONABLE.
